violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut tomato in container with ice water underneath (45°F)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. RELOCATED TO FRIDGE.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Around 10ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine.EHS INFORMED CFM ABOUT USING 3COMP SINK TO SANITIZE EQUIPMENT UNTIL EQUIPMENT IS FIXED.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: curries in the walk in cooler, cooked noodles, and prepared appetizer in the 2 door fridge.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM DATE MARKED FOODS.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: bags of raw chicken in a container under the 3 comp sink thawing for about 1 hr.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS REVIEWED ACCEPTABLE PRACTICES.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device that can take temperatures of cold foods. Thermometer started at 50°F.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Dishwasher not sanitizing equipment at 50ppm-100ppm concentration.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the equipment to 50ppm-100ppm chlorine solution. BANGKOK GOLDEN THAI RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 12/12/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling tile above the dishwasher is peeling. And the caulking at the 3 comp sink is not in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the COOKLINE is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. EHS OBSERVED HAND SINK NEXT TO COOKLINE BLOCKED BY CART OF COOKING SAUCES AND SPICES.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC MOVED CART.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. EHS OBSERVED VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS INCLUDING SOYBEAN OIL, COCONUT MILK, FISH SAUCE, AND CANS OF CORN ON FLOOR OF DRY STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC WILL OBTAIN SUFFICIENT, APPROVED STORAGE FOR ALL FOOD ITEMS. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS. EHS OBSERVED MANUFACTURERS GARLIC CONTAINERS BEING USED TO STORE VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS INCLUDING SAUCES, CORN, TOFU, GREEN ONION, AND COCONUT SUGAR IN COOLERS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC WILL OBTAIN SUFFICIENT, APPROVED STORAGE CONTAINERS FOR ALL FOOD ITEMS AND DISCARD MANUFACTURERS GARLIC CONTAINERS. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
